n03241651ce6.s: How many members does the Board of Peace, launched at the WEF Davos meeting in January 2026, have?
n03241651ce6.x: The Board of Peace has 27 members; it was launched by the US President for Gaza reconstruction, with India only an observer.

ndaa30f04b9e.s: The secretariat of CDRI, launched at the 2019 UN Climate Action Summit, is located in:
ndaa30f04b9e.x: CDRI was launched at the 2019 UN Climate Action Summit and has its secretariat in New Delhi.

n1e14fb1b65b.s: At the 18th BRICS Summit (New Delhi, September 2026), India was to hand over the BRICS chair for 2027 to:
n1e14fb1b65b.x: The 18th BRICS Summit was held at Bharat Mandapam on 12-13 September 2026, and the chair passes from India to China for 2027.

n2ac1b515fa1.s: The new collective finance goal of US$300 billion annually by 2035 was set at:
n2ac1b515fa1.x: COP29 at Baku (2024) set the US$300 billion annual goal by 2035 and proposed the Baku-to-Belém Roadmap to US$1.3 trillion.

nc9e5350fc38.s: In April 2026, India withdrew its bid to host which Climate COP?
nc9e5350fc38.x: India withdrew its COP33 (2028) bid by an Environment Ministry letter of 2 April 2026; South Korea was the only other contender.

cacb878fbacf67.s: Which one of the following countries is a member of the European Free Trade Association (EFTA)?
cacb878fbacf67.x: EFTA comprises Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland; Canada, Bhutan and Ghana are not members.

ca045434750d52.s: The European Free Trade Association (EFTA), established in 1960, is headquartered at:
ca045434750d52.x: EFTA was established in 1960 and is headquartered at Geneva.

ca3768b7d2c505.s: The Visegrád Group, formed in 1991, comprises the Czech Republic, Hungary, Poland and:
ca3768b7d2c505.x: The Visegrád Group (1991) comprises the Czech Republic, Hungary, Poland and Slovakia.

ca0675e49d560a.s: Under the US–Denmark–Greenland security arrangement of 18 September 2026, Greenland:
o: remained self-governing within the Kingdom of Denmark
ca0675e49d560a.x: Greenland's sovereignty was not transferred; it remained self-governing within Denmark, while the deal allowed a long-term US military presence.

ca98e676669d62.s: Where was the India–Liberia Group of Friends on Safety and Security of Shipping and Seafarers launched on 25 September 2026?
ca98e676669d62.x: It was launched in New York during the 81st UNGA High-Level Week; Monrovia is Liberia's capital.

ca130c4269839d.s: Which countries were the co-facilitators of the UNGA declaration on sea-level rise?
ca130c4269839d.x: The co-facilitators were Australia and Cabo Verde, not New Zealand.

caf83d19d9663f.s: According to the World Bank Global Economic Prospects, global growth was stabilising, led by:
caf83d19d9663f.x: The Global Economic Prospects reported growth stabilising under the lead of South and Southeast Asia, not Europe and North America.

ca6e492f08cc6d.s: Under the US–Denmark–Greenland security arrangement, sensitive investments in Greenland face security scrutiny by:
ca6e492f08cc6d.x: Sensitive investments in Greenland face US security scrutiny, not Danish.

cnf44b9970c9a7.s: The India Semiconductor Mission, launched in 2021, functions under:
cnf44b9970c9a7.x: The India Semiconductor Mission was launched in 2021 under MeitY, not the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.

cne4273b57348c.s: The Paris Agreement, adopted at COP21 in 2015, came into force in:
cne4273b57348c.x: The Paris Agreement was adopted in 2015 at COP21 and came into force in 2016.

cnde061770d895.s: Pratt & Whitney Canada, which signed an aerospace supply deal with Bharat Forge in October 2026, is a subsidiary of:
cnde061770d895.x: Pratt & Whitney Canada is a subsidiary of RTX Corporation, formed in 2020 by the merger of Raytheon and United Technologies' aerospace businesses.

cn60f5005f151b.s: The Southern Indian Ocean Fisheries Agreement (SIOFA), signed on 7 July 2006, came into force in:
cn60f5005f151b.x: SIOFA was signed on 7 July 2006 and came into force in June 2012.

cnc5377a0c49ce.s: Under the India–New Zealand FTA, FDI of US$20 billion is expected over:
cnc5377a0c49ce.x: The US$20 billion FDI is expected over 15 years, not 10.

cnb148f2d8763c.s: The Baratang Karst-Mud Volcano Complex, added to India's UNESCO Tentative List in October 2026, is in:
cnb148f2d8763c.x: Baratang Karst-Mud Volcano Complex is in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands; Sirpur is in Chhattisgarh.

cndea79c7b02f9.s: India's first World Heritage Sites, Ajanta, Ellora, Agra Fort and Taj Mahal, were inscribed in:
cndea79c7b02f9.x: India's first World Heritage Sites were inscribed in 1983; the Convention was adopted in 1972 and ratified by India in 1977.

cneac12d13582d.s: Inclusion of a site such as Sirpur in India's UNESCO Tentative List is:
o: inscription as a World Heritage Site
inscription on the List of World Heritage in Danger
the final approval of the World Heritage Committee
cneac12d13582d.x: Tentative listing is only a preliminary step before nomination, so it does not by itself make a site a World Heritage Site.

cn3073f778385f.s: Which body advises UNESCO on cultural sites for the World Heritage List?
cn3073f778385f.x: ICOMOS advises UNESCO on cultural sites; IUCN advises on natural sites.

cn96e3fc570d39.s: Which of the following additions to India's UNESCO Tentative List consists of Buddhist murals?
cn96e3fc570d39.x: Bagh Cave Paintings are Buddhist murals; Udayagiri Caves are of the Gupta period and Ginnorgarh is tribal heritage.

cn1139b228a376.s: After three sites including Sirpur were added on 22 October 2026, India's UNESCO Tentative List total became:
cn1139b228a376.x: The Tentative List grew from 73 to 78 and then to 81 with the three sites added on 22 October 2026.

cn5ffe7181863f.s: India ratified the UNESCO International Convention Against Doping in Sport on:
cn5ffe7181863f.x: India ratified the Convention on 7 November 2007; it was adopted on 19 October 2005 and came into force on 1 February 2007.

cn5bfe6eae38ef.s: The Terms of Reference for the India–Mexico Preferential Trade Agreement were signed in:
cn5bfe6eae38ef.x: The Terms of Reference for the India-Mexico PTA were signed in Mexico City.

cn521647a5e2c0.s: UNTMIS, the UN mission in Somalia, was created in 2024 by UNSC Resolution:
cn521647a5e2c0.x: UNTMIS was created in 2024 by UNSC Resolution 2753; it replaced UNSOM, set up in 2013 by Resolution 2102.

ca8d081707f6fa.s: Oman's position among India's trading partners in the Gulf is:
ca8d081707f6fa.x: Oman is India's second-largest trading partner in the Gulf; bilateral trade was USD 11.18 billion.

ca652358a559f1.s: In the June 2026 UNSC elections, how many votes did Kyrgyzstan win against the Philippines?
ca652358a559f1.x: Kyrgyzstan won 142 of 191 votes, above the 127 needed; Portugal and Austria defeated Germany.

ca87d9b23d29a1.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the UN Security Council?
o: Non-permanent members are elected in a secret ballot
Its non-permanent members serve four-year terms
Its five permanent members have veto power
Non-permanent members are elected by the UNGA by a two-thirds majority
ca87d9b23d29a1.x: Non-permanent members serve two-year terms, not four; the other statements are correct.

cacc14278301f8.s: The scientific name of the Indian peafowl, gifted by India to the UN Office at Geneva, is:
cacc14278301f8.x: The Indian peafowl is Pavo cristatus; Pavo muticus is the green peafowl.

new.s: The 51st G7 Summit (2025) was held at:
new.x: The 51st G7 Summit was at Kananaskis, Canada; the 52nd (2026) was at Evian-les-Bains, France.

new.s: Which country will host the 53rd G7 Summit in 2027?
new.x: The 53rd G7 Summit is to be hosted by the U.S. in 2027; France hosted the 52nd at Evian.

new.s: The 26th SCO Summit (2026) was held at:
new.x: The 26th SCO Summit was at Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan; the 25th (2025) was at Tianjin.

new.s: How many documents, including the Bishkek Declaration, were adopted at the 2026 SCO Summit?
new.x: The Bishkek Declaration was one of 28 documents and approved an SCO-CSTO-CIS roadmap.

new.s: Which country joined BRICS in January 2025?
new.x: Indonesia joined BRICS in January 2025; Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran and the UAE joined in 2024.

new.s: The theme of the 20th East Asia Summit (2025), Kuala Lumpur, was:
o: One Earth, One Family, One Future
new.x: The 20th EAS theme was 'Inclusivity and Sustainability'; the others are BIMSTEC 2025 and G20 2025 and 2023 themes.

new.s: India's G20 Presidency term ran from:
new.x: India held the G20 Presidency from 1 December 2022 to 30 November 2023.

new.s: Under India's 2023 G20 Presidency, meetings were held in about how many cities?
new.x: G20 meetings under India's Presidency were held in about 60 cities across all States and UTs.

new.s: The Digital Innovation Alliance launched at G20 2025 was formed by:
new.x: The Digital Innovation Alliance was launched by India, Brazil and South Africa; India, USA and Brazil founded the Global Biofuels Alliance.

new.s: The G20 works through the Finance track and the:
new.x: The G20 works through a Finance track and a Sherpa track; the Troika is past, present and next presidencies.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the 20th G20 Summit (Johannesburg, November 2025):
1. It was the first G20 Summit held on African soil.
2. The U.S. skipped the summit.
3. Its theme was 'One Earth, One Family, One Future'.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Its theme was 'Solidarity, Equality, and Sustainability'; 'One Earth, One Family, One Future' was India's 2023 theme.

new.s: The first India–Central Asia Summit, held virtually on 27 January 2022, adopted the:
new.x: The first India-Central Asia Summit, chaired by PM Modi, adopted the Delhi Declaration; leaders agreed to meet every two years.

new.s: How many Quad leader-level summits were held in 2025?
new.x: There were six Quad leader-level summits in 2021-2024 but none in 2025.

new.s: The IBSA Fund is managed by:
new.x: The IBSA Fund is managed by the UN Office for South-South Cooperation (UNOSSC).

new.s: The SAARC Development Fund secretariat is located at:
new.x: The SAARC Development Fund secretariat is at Thimphu; the last SAARC summit was at Kathmandu in 2014.

new.s: The Mission Innovation (MI-8) clean energy ministerial of July 2023 was held at:
new.x: The MI-8 ministerial on clean energy was held at Goa in July 2023.

new.s: The Summit for a New Global Financing Pact (22–23 June 2023) was held at:
new.x: The Summit for a New Global Financing Pact was held at Paris in June 2023.

new.s: The One Health Summit 2026, under France's G7 Presidency, was held at:
new.x: The One Health Summit 2026 was at Lyon, not Geneva; Nice hosted the UN Ocean Conference.

new.s: The WEF 'Summer Davos' (Annual Meeting of the New Champions) of June 2026 was held at:
new.x: Summer Davos was held at Dalian, China; Davos hosts the WEF Annual Meeting.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Indian Ocean Conference:
1. Its 9th edition was held in Mauritius in April 2026.
2. It was started in 2016 by the India Foundation.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: the 9th Indian Ocean Conference was in Mauritius (April 2026), and the series was started in 2016 by the India Foundation.

new.s: The AI Impact Summit 2026 was based on which human-centred AI vision of India?
new.x: The AI Impact Summit was based on India's M.A.N.A.V. human-centred AI vision under the IndiaAI Mission.

new.s: The New Delhi Declaration on AI Impact (2026) carries the motto:
o: One Earth, One Family, One Future
new.x: The New Delhi Declaration on AI Impact carries 'Sarvajan Hitaya, Sarvajan Sukhaya'; it is voluntary and non-binding.

new.s: COP31 (November 2026) is being held at:
new.x: COP31 is at Antalya, Türkiye; COP32 (2027) is at Addis Ababa.

new.s: Which country presides over negotiations at COP31 as co-president?
new.x: Türkiye holds the COP31 presidency while Australia presides over negotiations as co-president.

new.s: COP32 (2027) will be held at:
new.x: COP32 will be held at Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.

new.s: The first Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity was held at:
new.x: The first CBD COP was held at Nassau, Bahamas, in 1994; COP16 was at Cali.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about COP30 (Belém, 2025)?
o: It was the first COP held in the Amazon
It agreed to triple adaptation finance by 2035
It set up the Belém Action Mechanism for just transition
new.x: COP30 adopted no fossil-fuel roadmap; the other three are among its outcomes.

new.s: LeadIT, the heavy-industry transition initiative, is co-chaired by India and:
new.x: LeadIT is co-chaired by India and Sweden; ISA was launched by India and France.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (alliance – founders) is correctly matched?
o: International Solar Alliance – India and Sweden
Global Biofuels Alliance – India, USA and Brazil
Digital Innovation Alliance – India, USA and Brazil
new.x: The Global Biofuels Alliance was founded by India, USA and Brazil; ISA is India and France, LeadIT India and Sweden.

new.s: The International Solar Alliance was launched by India and France at:
new.x: ISA was launched by India and France at COP21, Paris, in 2015; it is headquartered at Gurugram.

new.s: Investments announced at the CII Partnership Summit 2025 in Visakhapatnam amounted to:
new.x: The CII Partnership Summit 2025 (Visakhapatnam, 14-15 November 2025) drew investments of ₹2,80,384 crore.

new.s: Under the India–EFTA TEPA, the target of 1 million direct jobs is spread over:
new.x: TEPA targets USD 100 billion investment and 1 million direct jobs over 15 years, not 1 year.

new.s: The India–EFTA TEPA, signed on 10 March 2024, came into force on:
new.x: TEPA was signed on 10 March 2024 and came into force on 1 October 2025.

new.s: New Zealand's Parliament passed the India–New Zealand FTA legislation on:
new.x: NZ Parliament passed it on 16 September 2026; it was signed on 27 April 2026 and came into force on 20 October 2026.

new.s: The secretariat of the UN Convention against Cybercrime is:
new.x: The Convention, adopted by UNGA Resolution 79/243, has UNODC as its secretariat.

new.s: The UN Convention against Cybercrime becomes binding:
new.x: It becomes binding 90 days after 40 ratifications; 72 states signed at Hanoi in October 2025.

new.s: The secretariat of the International Whaling Commission is located at:
new.x: The IWC secretariat is at Impington, Cambridge (UK); the convention was signed at Washington and the 70th meeting was at Hobart.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the International Whaling Commission:
1. Its 70th meeting was held at Hobart, Australia.
2. It works under a convention signed at Washington in 1946.
3. Commercial whaling has been under a moratorium since 1986.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: All three are correct: the 70th IWC meeting was at Hobart, the convention was signed at Washington on 2 December 1946, and the moratorium dates from 1986.

new.s: 175 countries finalised a legally binding global plastics treaty at:
new.x: The global plastics treaty was finalised in Geneva; the ICJ gave only an advisory opinion.

new.s: The 14th WTO Ministerial Conference (MC14), March 2026, was held at:
new.x: WTO MC14 was held at Yaoundé, Cameroon, in March 2026 and ended without consensus.

new.s: After WTO MC14, the WTO-wide e-commerce moratorium on customs duties on electronic transmissions:
o: was made permanent for all members
new.x: The moratorium, in place since 1998, lapsed on 30 March 2026; only a plurilateral group applies it among themselves.

new.s: Which country is NOT among the co-sponsors of the plurilateral e-commerce moratorium proposal of 1 September 2026?
new.x: The 25 co-sponsor entries include the US, EU, UK, Japan, Australia and Singapore; India is not among them.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (WTO term – subject) is correctly matched?
o: Amber Box – minimally distorting support with no limit
Green Box – trade-distorting support subject to reduction
Blue Box – payments under production-limiting programmes
new.x: Blue Box covers payments under production-limiting programmes; Amber is trade-distorting, Green is minimally distorting, and TRIMs is about investment measures.

new.s: Under the WTO Agreement on Agriculture, the de minimis limit for developing countries such as India is:
new.x: De minimis support is exempt up to 10% of production value for developing countries and 5% for developed countries.

new.s: The Dunkel Draft (20 December 1991), which became the basis of the WTO, was the Draft Final Act of the:
new.x: The Dunkel Draft was the Uruguay Round's Draft Final Act, prepared by GATT Director-General Arthur Dunkel.

new.s: Public stockholding for food security falls under which WTO category of farm support?
new.x: The Green Box covers minimally distorting support with no limit, including public stockholding for food security.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India in the IMF?
o: Each SDR 1 million of quota gives one extra vote
India's quota is about 2.75% of the total
new.x: Votes are 250 basic votes plus one per SDR 100,000 of quota, not per SDR 1 million.

new.s: In the SDR basket (weights from 1 August 2022), which currency has the second-highest weight?
new.x: The weights are US dollar 43.38%, euro 29.31%, renminbi 12.28%, yen 7.59% and pound 7.44%.

new.s: The IMF 16th General Review of Quotas takes effect only when members holding what share of total quotas consent?
new.x: It needs consent from members holding 85% of quotas; by 29 October 2025 only 72.78% had consented.

new.s: Which country became the 21st member of the euro area on 1 January 2026?
new.x: Bulgaria became the 21st euro-area member on 1 January 2026 at 1.95583 lev to one euro.

new.s: Uzbekistan, which joined the New Development Bank on 5 June 2026, became its:
new.x: Uzbekistan became the NDB's 10th member and its first Central Asian member.

new.s: With Colombia's approval in November 2025, the AIIB's approved membership reached:
new.x: Colombia's approval as a prospective member took AIIB's approved membership to 111.

new.s: In September 2026, WHO validated Timor-Leste for eliminating which disease as a public health problem?
new.x: WHO validated Timor-Leste on 3 September 2026 for eliminating trachoma as a public health problem.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about WHO's trachoma validation of September 2026:
1. The country validated was Timor-Leste.
2. The award was presented on 8 September 2026.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: WHO validated Timor-Leste on 3 September 2026 and presented the award on 8 September 2026.

new.s: The Global Economic Prospects report is published by:
new.x: Global Economic Prospects is a World Bank report.

new.s: Who is the President of the Asian Development Bank?
new.x: Masato Kanda heads the ADB (HQ Mandaluyong, Metro Manila); Ajay Banga heads the World Bank.

new.s: Who is the President of the World Bank?
new.x: Ajay Banga is World Bank President; Kristalina Georgieva is IMF Managing Director.

new.s: Who is the Managing Director of the IMF?
new.x: Kristalina Georgieva is the IMF Managing Director; the IMF and World Bank are both headquartered in Washington DC.

new.s: Under the India–New Zealand FTA, bilateral trade is targeted to rise from US$2.4 billion to ____ by 2030.
new.x: The target is to raise trade from US$2.4 billion to NZ$7 billion by 2030; US$20 billion is the expected FDI.

new.s: The Joint Crediting Mechanism was launched by Japan in 2013 with which first partner country?
new.x: Japan launched the JCM in 2013 and its first partner was Mongolia.

new.s: How many World Heritage Sites did India have after its Tentative List reached 81 in October 2026?
new.x: The Tentative List rose to 81, but India's World Heritage Sites stayed at 45.

new.s:
Arrange the following FTAs in the order India implemented them:
1. India–Mauritius
2. India–Australia
3. India–Oman
new.x: India implemented FTAs in the order Mauritius, UAE, Australia, EFTA and Oman, with the UK CETA sixth.

new.s: The India–UK Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) was signed on:
new.x: CETA was signed on 25 July 2025 and came into force on 15 July 2026.

new.s: The India–UK CETA gives duty-free access in the UK to what share of Indian products?
new.x: CETA gives duty-free access for 99% of Indian products; 99.38% is the India-Oman CEPA figure.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC):
1. It was established in 1981.
2. Its headquarters is at Riyadh.
3. It has seven members.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. The GCC has six members: Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and UAE.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a member of the Gulf Cooperation Council?
new.x: The GCC's six members are Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and UAE; Iran is not one.

new.s: The Southern African Customs Union (SACU) is headquartered at:
new.x: SACU, established in 1910, is headquartered at Windhoek, Namibia.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a member of the Southern African Customs Union?
new.x: SACU's five members are Botswana, Eswatini, Lesotho, Namibia and South Africa.

new.s: Who was elected President of the 81st UN General Assembly (2026–27)?
new.x: Bangladesh's Khalilur Rahman was elected, as it was the Asia-Pacific Group's turn; he beat the Cyprus candidate.

new.s: The UNSC election for India's bid for the 2028–29 non-permanent seat will be held in:
new.x: India seeks the Asia group seat for 2028-29 in the election of June 2027; its rival is Tajikistan.

new.s: The International Criminal Court, from whose Rome Statute Venezuela is withdrawing, is headquartered at:
new.x: The ICC, established in 2002 under the 1998 Rome Statute, is headquartered at The Hague.

new.s: Which site was inscribed as India's 45th World Heritage Site in July 2026?
new.x: The 48th World Heritage Committee inscribed the Ancient Buddhist Site of Sarnath, near Varanasi, as India's 45th site.

new.s: The 48th session of the World Heritage Committee (20–29 July 2026) was held at:
new.x: The 48th World Heritage Committee met at Busan, South Korea.

new.s: In July 2026, WHO validated which country for eliminating trachoma as a public health problem?
new.x: WHO validated El Salvador in July 2026 for eliminating trachoma as a public health problem.

new.s: El Salvador was validated by WHO in July 2026 for eliminating which disease as a public health problem?
new.x: WHO's July 2026 validation of El Salvador was for eliminating trachoma.

new.s: In July 2026, Russia's share in India's oil imports reached an all-time high of over:
new.x: Russia supplied over 51% of India's oil imports in July 2026, after falling below 20% in January 2026.

new.s: In June 2026, Anthropic opened Claude Mythos Preview to about how many critical infrastructure organisations in India and 15+ countries?
new.x: Under Project Glasswing, Claude Mythos Preview opened on 2 June 2026 to about 150 critical infrastructure organisations.

new.s: Which became the first Arab country to adopt a statutory alternative to the death penalty?
new.x: Lebanon ended the death penalty, becoming the first Arab country to adopt a statutory alternative to it.

new.s: The World Bank's Global Economic Prospects (June 2026) projected India's FY2026-27 growth at:
new.x: GEP raised India's FY2026-27 projection to 6.6% from 6.5%; 6.4% is the IMF WEO figure.

new.s: The IMF's World Economic Outlook Update (July 2026) projected global growth for 2026 at:
new.x: The IMF projected 3.0% for 2026; 2.5% is the World Bank figure and 2.8% the OECD figure.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (report – publisher) is correctly matched?
new.x: The OECD publishes the Economic Outlook; Global Economic Prospects is the World Bank's and the World Economic Outlook the IMF's.

new.s: Rebeca Grynspan, the first woman to head UNCTAD, is a national of:
new.x: Rebeca Grynspan of Costa Rica has headed UNCTAD since September 2021.

new.s: Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala, who began a second four-year term as WTO Director-General on 1 September 2025, is from:
new.x: WTO Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala is Nigerian.

new.s: Who became President and CEO of the World Economic Forum after Børge Brende stepped down in February 2026?
new.x: Alois Zwinggi succeeded Børge Brende as WEF President and CEO; the WEF is headquartered at Cologny, Geneva.

new.s: How many member countries does the IMF have?
new.x: The IMF has 191 member countries.

new.s: The weight of the renminbi in the SDR basket (from 1 August 2022) is:
new.x: The renminbi weighs 12.28%; 29.31% is the euro, 7.59% the yen and 7.44% the pound.

new.s: With a quota of SDR 13,114.4 million, India is the IMF's ____ largest quota holder.
new.x: India's quota of SDR 13,114.4 million (about 2.75%) makes it the 8th-largest quota holder.

new.s: The 14th WTO Ministerial Conference (March 2026), which ended without consensus, was held at:
new.x: MC14 was held at Yaoundé, Cameroon; the e-commerce moratorium lapsed after it.

new.s: The WTO Agreement on Trade-Related Investment Measures (TRIMs) applies to:
new.x: TRIMs applies to goods only, not services.

new.s: In June 2026, the World Bank approved ₹4,000 crore for the Jal Sanrakshit project of which state?
new.x: The World Bank approved ₹4,000 crore for the ₹5,714-crore Jal Sanrakshit Haryana Project.

new.s: India's first World Bank Step-Up Loan ($225 million) was for highway modernisation in:
new.x: Rajasthan's $225 million highway modernisation loan was India's first Step-Up Loan.

new.s: Which country joined the New Development Bank on 5 June 2026 as its first Central Asian member?
new.x: Uzbekistan joined the NDB on 5 June 2026 as its 10th and first Central Asian member; Iran only said it would soon join.

new.s: UNIFIL, whose mandate was extended 'for one last time' to 31 December 2026, operates in:
new.x: UNIFIL is the UN Interim Force in Lebanon.

new.s: UNIFIL's final mandate extension to 31 December 2026 was made by UNSC Resolution:
new.x: UNSC Resolution 2790 (August 2025) extended UNIFIL for one last time, with withdrawal within a year after.
